description: Required workers exceed workers available
rationale: Logical shortfall condition; carries no numeric threshold. Risk existence: M01, M07.

description: Stock on site runs out before a new delivery can arrive (for the material with the longest lead time)
rationale: Logical stock-out condition: stock days at or below the lead time leave no margin (a tie is a stock-out risk). Carries no numeric threshold. Risk existence: M01, M06.

description: Stock on site covers fewer days than the planned duration
rationale: Restocking is required during the activity, so the risk is relevant; it is not raised to elevated by this fact alone. Whether it fails depends on lead time (see RL-MAT, which wins when both fire).

description: Tools or equipment shortage expected
rationale: User-declared condition.

description: Activity period overlaps the monsoon / rainy season
rationale: Calendar overlap declared by the user. Internal walls can continue in rain, so monsoon alone marks the risk as relevant only (see RL-WX2 for external walls).

description: Masonry is done at height and scaffolding is not ready
rationale: Work at height alone applies to almost every superstructure wall, so it is raised only when scaffolding is not ready. M01 ranks working at heights among the listed factors.

description: Payment delays occurred previously or are expected
rationale: User-declared condition.

description: Drawings or details are incomplete
rationale: User-declared condition.

description: Rework was frequent in earlier work on this site or crew
rationale: User-declared condition.

description: Planner or site engineer judges the programme faster than the gang can achieve
rationale: User-declared (subjective) condition. See RL-PACE for the checkable form.

description: Skilled masons are fewer than needed
rationale: User-declared condition.

description: Monsoon overlaps the activity and external walls are in scope
rationale: Logical condition declared by the user; external walls are the work that rain stops. Risk existence: A09 (Kolkata monsoon), P1-05.

description: Planned daily output is higher than the output achieved last week
rationale: Checkable form of RL-PLAN: both facts are User Input in the same unit (the user chooses it once); no norm is used.

description: Floors or walls planned for the next 7 days are not de-propped, cleared and handed over
rationale: User-declared condition. Risk existence: D01, P1-05. Masonry-specific form: Expert Judgment, to be confirmed by the expert survey.

description: Masonry is above the ground floor and no hoist or material lift is available
rationale: Floor 0 is the ground floor, so the only number is the floor index 1. Risk existence (related): P1-02, P3-02. Expert Judgment, to be confirmed by the expert survey.

description: Scaffolding is not ready
rationale: User-declared condition. Risk existence: P1-05, P3-01. Expert Judgment, to be confirmed by the expert survey.

description: Sand or cement stock runs out before a new delivery can arrive
rationale: Same logical stock-out condition as RL-MAT, for mortar materials. Risk existence: A02, D01.

description: The gang's weekly payment or the labour contractor's bill is overdue
rationale: User-declared condition. Risk existence: A08 (abstract only), D21.

description: Door/window frames, MEP sleeve layout or lintel-level plan is not ready
rationale: Any one of the three being 'No' fires the rule. If one is left blank and the others are 'Yes', the rule is reported as not evaluable. Risk existence (related): M10, M06.

description: A major festival, harvest or election falls inside the activity window
rationale: Calendar fact declared by the user: the risk is relevant only. Expert Judgment (to be confirmed by the expert survey) for the Indian form.

description: A festival, harvest or election falls inside the window and the gang is mostly migrant
rationale: Raised above RL-FEST (priority 1) when the gang is mostly migrant. Expert Judgment, to be confirmed by the expert survey.

description: The activity overlaps peak summer
rationale: Calendar fact declared by the user: the risk is relevant only. Heat figures from brick-making (P2-06) are not used.
